title: Extension Redesign
meta: A cleaner, modern interface for your existing extension, built without losing users or saved data. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Extension redesign with a modern, clearer interface
overview: We redesign how your extension looks and feels while the logic underneath stays working. First we review your current screens and sketch the new layout with you. Then we rebuild the popup, settings and any panels with a consistent style, new icons, clear spacing and readable text. Existing users keep their data. You get the new interface in the code, plus a short style guide for future changes.

pkgs.blurb: A refreshed popup with tidy spacing, type and icons.
Popup and settings redesigned with a consistent visual style.
A full interface refresh with animation and a reusable style guide.

faq: Will existing users notice a broken experience?
No. We change the look and layout, not the stored data or core logic. We test the old and new versions side by side so every saved setting still shows up in the new screens.
Do I need to give you my designs?
Not at all. You can share brand colors, a logo and any apps you like for reference, and we propose the layout. If you already have designs, we build from them.
Can you redesign without the source code?
We need the source files to rebuild the interface properly. If you only have the published package, we can often unpack it, but we confirm what is possible before quoting.
Will the redesign change my permissions?
No. A visual refresh does not need new permissions, so users are not shown a fresh warning and the update goes through the normal review.
